title: Resolution urging Albany to require arts and music education
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, S.6318A/A.6490B, which would require arts and music instruction in curriculums for all public school students and require certified teachers to provide it. It cites a 2024-2025 report showing only 31% of eighth graders met state arts education guidelines and testimony that 310 NYC schools lack a dance, fine arts, music or theater teacher.
